- unique targetChapters: 1, 5, 6, 9, 10, 12, 17, 18
- id: MAP-0151919B70
- assessment: designed
- sourceEvidence:
  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts:650-730: short option/stock and mixed long/short cases assert signed exposure, multiplier-aware PnL, and net liquidation.
- currentBehavior: setPositions 注入 long/short，getAccount 聚合 signed market values，验证 entry mark 与 mixed book。
- problem: 依赖 mutable map/bare USD，没有 FX/staleness/scope/event order/rebuild，injector 可造 impossible state。
- targetModel: Signed ExposureSnapshot and AccountProjection carry Long/Short direction, typed units and explicit valuation completeness. Known exposure survives missing FX/mark; only a later controlled effect may require complete valuation as a precondition.
- pureTransitions:
  - SignedValuation(exposure,price,fx) -&gt; Result&lt;MoneyValuation,ValuationFailure&gt;.
  - AggregateAccount(cash,valuations) -&gt; Result&lt;AccountProjection,ProjectionFailure&gt;.
  - ReplayAccounting(events) -&gt; AccountProjection.
- effectBoundary: Observation ingress is an Effect; signed math, FX policy and fold/replay are pure. Account reads do not use order locks or compensation.
- durability: Exposure observations carry scope, instrument, version and time; restart does not require setPositions.
- errors:
  - MissingFx -&gt; Incomplete valuation.
  - InvalidSide/Multiplier -&gt; schema failure.
  - StalePrice -&gt; explicit risk.
  - OutOfOrder -&gt; retain newer version and audit.
- preservedBehavior:
  - Retain short OPT/STK and mixed signed aggregation.
  - Retain entry-mark netLiq/PnL equations.
- replacementSteps:
  - Move cases to pure accounting and typed observations.
  - Add incomplete/rebuild evidence without making data reads executable effects.
- verificationCases:
  - Short OPT and mixed book retain signed equity.
  - Mixed rebuild yields netLiq10200/PnL200.
  - Missing FX/mark preserves positions with Incomplete status and no fabricated total.
- openQuestions: —
- contractDisposition: reframed
- contractRationale: Signed long/short valuation is retained as an accounting projection fact with incomplete-status handling; the target does not claim an order transaction for valuation reads.

  - [K12](../composition-contract.md)

### MAP-150B8F86DC

- mapping source: [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts:917-966](../../../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts#L917-L966)
- symbol: _applyFill
- unique targetChapters: 1, 3, 5, 6, 9, 10, 12, 18, 20
- id: MAP-150B8F86DC
- assessment: designed
- sourceEvidence:
  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts:917-966: _applyFill mutates maps, WAC, partial/full close, rejects SELL without position/oversell, and never flips side.
- currentBehavior: same-side increases WAC；opposite reduces/deletes；negative remainder throws generic Error；SELL 无仓不 flip。
- problem: 关键 invariant buried in mutable adapter/error strings，无 scope/typed Fill/event/atomic cash；externalTrade 有另一 short-open policy。_applyFill 接受 string side 且除 SELL 外的空仓方向会落入 long-open 分支；domain parser must reject unknown action/side instead of treating it as BUY/long。
- targetModel: evolveExposure is a pure reducer over typed Fill and SourcePolicy. Alice-controlled SELL without exposure rejects; OutsideAlice external execution may open short. This reducer is reusable by effect observation and external-fact ingestion without making both paths one transaction.
- pureTransitions:
  - EvolveExposure(exposure,fill,sourcePolicy) -&gt; Result&lt;ExposureTransition,FillFailure&gt;.
  - ComputeCashDelta(fill,multiplier) -&gt; Money.
  - ApplyTransition(projection,eventVersion) -&gt; projection|conflict.
- effectBoundary: Arithmetic/rejection are pure; Mock venue emits facts. Controlled-effect observations use the order journal; external facts use their own observation/fact store and reconciliation boundary, with neither path turning an ordinary data read into approval or compensation.
- durability: Event retains action/execution identity, scope/instrument, before/after version and multiplier; rejected fill has no cash event; Unknown recovers through observation.
- errors:
  - SellWithoutExposure(source=Alice) -&gt; rejected/no cash.
  - Oversell -&gt; no state delta.
  - FlipNotAllowed -&gt; explicit policy failure.
  - DuplicateExecution -&gt; no-op.
  - InvalidSide -&gt; protocol violation.
- preservedBehavior:
  - Retain WAC, partial/full close, no-flip and oversell-no-credit.
  - Keep external short as separate source policy.
- replacementSteps:
  - Extract pure reducer and failure variants.
  - Consume it from typed observation paths and remove private mutable helper.
- verificationCases:
  - long10@100 plus buy5@120 has exact WAC.
  - Sell1.1 against held1 has no cash/exposure event.
  - Unknown side never enters empty-position branch.
- openQuestions: —
- contractDisposition: retained
- contractRationale: WAC, partial/full close, no-flip and oversell-no-credit remain pure reducer invariants; source policy distinguishes Alice effects from external facts without inventing native guarantees.
- contractAnchors:
  - [K04](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K05](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K08](../composition-contract.md)

  - Serialized payload contains no SDK and no omitted supported field.

## Cross-group contracts

- Mock contributes provider-scoped declaration leaves and exact schemas; the current IBroker/global switch remains source evidence only. The target has no universal closed action set, no mandatory placeholder leaf for every operation and no Unsupported-filled universal SDK.
- Each declared leaf composes its semantic unit, input/result/error schema, native extension and resource requirements. Provider-specific HOFs preserve exact extensions; structural absence removes unsupported leaves and empty parents.
- Only controlled trading effects use withTransaction and durable intent/approval/dispatch/recovery. Candle/Instrument/News/NewsGroup data units, account/position/order reads, pull results and push streams do not inherit order WAL, approval or compensation.
- The Mock adapter may use pure reducers and an independent DurableMockVenue. JournalWriter/CAS/idempotency/reconcile rules remain for effect execution; data observation/cache failures do not trigger transaction compensation.
- AccountScope is required only by account/order facts, order references, execution intent and related conflicts/authorization; public Instrument/Candle/News/NewsGroup and ordinary market-data leaves use their own declared Public/venue/instrument scope. Canonical identities, metadata versions and source/sequence evidence remain boundary facts. Native protocols, SDK classes and provider extensions stay inside the adapter; no native idempotency, absence, atomicity or reversibility guarantee is invented.
- CapabilityDescriptor availability is resolved per provider instance, each leaf's declared Public/Account/resource scope, session and permissions. Adding a provider field changes declaration-derived schema/validation/metadata/CLI without a kernel capability switch; event triggers are evidence, never approval.

## Additional findings

- Unmapped physical gaps in services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts (39, 53, 77, 109, 161-163, 216, 253, 258, 274-277, 326, 356, 368, 384-386, 416, 436, 477-478, 512-513, 518, 522-524, 544-545, 579, 629, 664, 756, 798, 840, 845, 857, 889, 903, 914-916, 967, 979) were inspected beside neighboring constructs; they are separators, headings or closing braces, not additional executable behavior. No new Mock capability is inferred from them.
- MockBroker.ts:104-108 advertises STP LMT while :799-839 collapses it to a trigger-time fill. Under capability composition the source contradiction remains evidence; the target omits/refuses a StopLimit leaf until a real trigger-to-working-limit state machine is independently evidenced.
- MockBroker.ts:675-697 stores external deposits by raw nativeKey while :639-649 may choose another localSymbol and :917-923 keys fills via getNativeKey. The target records this as an identity conflict and does not silently split or merge exposure.
- The mapped controls distinguish a legitimate externally opened short from Alice SELL rejection. The target preserves both through source-specific facts/policies; it does not infer native short guarantees or turn a control into approval.
- Native evidence remains unresolved for provider idempotency scope, complete absence, atomicity, compensation/reversibility, stream replay/finality and durable venue implementation. These are implementation acceptance obligations, not solved by the Mock abstractions.
- The current IBroker/global switch and legacy class are retained only in sourceEvidence/currentBehavior. They are not target composition requirements; the cutover must migrate each caller to the declared Mock leaf that actually exists.
